question.origin: Fixed general guideline-management question; not derived from reference or path

options.label: A
options.action: Attempt rescue from a safe location by reaching with an object, throwing a rope or floating object, or rowing to the drowning patient without entering hazardous conditions.

options.label: B
options.action: Do not enter hazardous water to attempt rescue; await or summon trained rescue personnel if available.

options.label: C
options.action: Perform in-water rescue according to level of training, expertise, equipment, and comfort level.

options.label: D
options.action: Avoid entering the water for rescue; attempt reach/throw/row strategies from a safe location if possible.

options.label: E
options.action: Insufficient explicit patient evidence to select a guideline recommendation.

candidate_rules.text: Apply this recommendation only when ALL requirements hold: The answer must be YES: Is the rescuer without formal water rescue training operating in hazardous water conditions (eg, beyond ability to safely enter the water)? AND The answer must be NO: Is the drowning patient within reach, or can a rope/floating object/boat/canoe/paddleboard be used from a safe location?. Recommendation: Do not enter hazardous water to attempt rescue; await or summon trained rescue personnel if available.
